name: 会話内の複数メッセージ選択パネル
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese mobile conversation screen in message-selection mode, exactly 390 × 642 px. Use the native preview as the exact guide for copy, layout, spacing, colors and target frame. Use the source crop for the original WhatsApp selection context; follow the preview’s clean white adaptation rather than its wallpaper. No phone frame, status bar, home indicator, or watermark.

Top header: left-aligned bold dark `山田 はるか`; right-aligned green `キャンセル`. Below, show a pale-mint date pill `昨日`, then two compact pale-mint selected message bubbles, each with a small green circle and white check to its left. Each bubble contains exactly two dark lines `明日は一日空いています。` and `みなさんの予定はどうですか？`, plus small muted-gray `00:32` at bottom right. Next show a pale-mint `今日` date pill and one more selected bubble with the same exact two lines and time. Preserve the three-message sample and positions from the native preview.

At the bottom, add the thin light-gray divider and compact selection toolbar: gray curved reply/back arrow at left, centered dark `4件を選択`, gray trash outline, gray share/send arrow at right. Keep the three green selection check circles visible and aligned with their message bubbles.

None of the text in the Japanese native preview is underlined or marked as a hyperlink; keep all message text dark and do not make it blue. The green selection checks are icons, not linked text. Use clean Meiryo-like Japanese sans serif, pale-mint fills, generous white space and crisp exact Japanese copy. No decorative wallpaper or extra messages.
reviewNotes: Japanese copy and screen structure match; message bubbles are wider than the 390x642 native preview. No linked text appears in the preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
